title: Recommended tour
text: I took the Spanish Civil War tour and loved it. Donato did a super job of situating the process historically and contrasting narratives, with a critical and reflective look. His explanations were quite clear (even for someone like me who didn’t have much prior knowledge) and he always answered all our doubts. He even shared information to keep learning after the tour. I recommend the experience with Donato 100%!
author: flaviamH5953YF

title: Dynamic account of tragic events
text: Excellent!!! Donato is very knowledgeable about what happened in Barcelona during the civil war in particular and in general about the entire previous political context that led to that terrible fraticidal tragedy. High recommendation for this free tour
